title: Add Two Numbers - Solution
approach: Iterative element addition with carry tracking.
intuition: Given two non-empty linked lists representing two non-negative integers. The digits are stored in reverse order. Add the two numbers and return the sum as a linked list.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Iterative element addition with carry tracking.
code:
def solution(l1, l2):
    class ListNode:
        def __init__(self, val=0, next=None):
            self.val = val
            self.next = next
    dummy = ListNode(0)
    curr = dummy
    carry = 0
    while l1 or l2 or carry:
        v1 = l1.val if l1 else 0
        v2 = l2.val if l2 else 0
        val = v1 + v2 + carry
        carry = val // 10
        curr.next = ListNode(val % 10)
        curr = curr.next
        if l1: l1 = l1.next
        if l2: l2 = l2.next
    return dummy.next
common_mistakes: Iterate through both lists. Keep track of the carry value.
